research_notes: The start pre-arm design is already a strong structural improvement because it removes scheduler mutation from the late critical path.
The remaining late critical path is chiefly completion of the smallest safe work unit plus durable close checkpoint.
Future soft-cutoff design should therefore protect this close path rather than reserve time for scheduler writes that already happened.
This can permit a smaller reserve than older end-of-turn scheduling designs if close measurements support it.
However the reserve must still account for GitHub/checkpoint latency and runtime variance.
These hypotheses will be tested only after sufficient close-overhead samples are collected.
